turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
Shipping times vary depending on the delivery address and the items in your order. A tracking number is created as soon as the order leaves our warehouse.

Depending on the carrier, the tracking link may only be sent on the morning of delivery, and delivery updates can appear as late as one hour before the courier arrives. You can also check your Tediber account under “Mes commandes”.

For the status of your specific order, please send me your order number.

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Delivery time depends on the delivery address and the items in your order.

For a small parcel, delivery is usually within 48 to 72 hours. An order containing only a mattress, without a removal service, is eligible for delivery within 48 hours.

You can find the estimated delivery date for a specific item in the “Ma livraison dès le...” section on its product page.

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail: Unfortunately, Tediber cannot bring the delivery date forward or ask the delivery company to change its schedule. Your order will be delivered within the time slot communicated when you placed it. The courier may call shortly before arrival or if you are absent.

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail: Please send me your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number used when ordering. I’ll then check the shipment status and advise you on the next step if the tracking has not updated.
turns.replyText: Please send me your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number used when ordering. I’ll then check the shipment status and advise you on the next step if the tracking has not updated.

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
You can find your tracking link by logging in to your Tediber account and opening “Mes commandes”. The tracking number appears once your order has left the warehouse.

If your order is being delivered by Geodis/France Express, the link may be sent on the morning of the delivery day. For EDELIV deliveries, it is provided about one hour before the scheduled arrival.

turns.q: My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
turns.replyTail: I’m sorry your tracking shows the parcel as delivered when you have not received it. Please send me your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number used when ordering so I can check the delivery and arrange the next step.

turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail: Please send me your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number used when ordering. I’ll then check whether the delivery address can still be changed.
turns.replyText: Please send me your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number used when ordering. I’ll then check whether the delivery address can still be changed.

turns.q: Do you compensate for a long delay?
turns.replyTail:
A compensation is not automatic for a delayed order. Each situation must be reviewed individually.

Please send me your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number used when ordering, along with the delivery date that was initially communicated. I can then have your request reviewed based on the delay.
